documents.title: Quarterly Compliance Report on Corporate governance - within 21 days from the end of the quarter

analysis.summary: Silkflex Polymers held its Q4 FY26 earnings conference call, highlighting the commencement of full-scale commercial production at its Vadodara facility. Management reported strong financial performance for the quarter and full year, driven by operating leverage, cost control, and the transition toward in-house manufacturing. The company outlined its strategic focus on scaling manufacturing capacity utilization, expanding its product portfolio into non-textile applications, and growing its wood-coating segment. Furthermore, management addressed questions regarding working capital, inventory levels, and debt reduction through internal accruals. Silkflex Polymers reported its financial performance for the fourth quarter and full year of FY26, highlighting revenue growth and transition to a manufacturing-led model through its newly commissioned automated plant in Vadodara.

guidance.claim: The company expects to reach full capacity utilization by the end of financial year '27.
guidance.quote: So, we are expecting to reach full capacity utilization, by the end of financial year '27.

guidance.claim: Overall EBITDA can increase by 200 to 300 basis points with complete plant utilization.
guidance.quote: So overall EBITDA can increase by 200-300 basis points. If seen overall, we can expect expansion by 2% to 3%.

guidance.claim: Management expects full capacity utilization of the new manufacturing plant by the next financial year.
guidance.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

guidance.claim: The company expects trading and manufacturing to contribute equally to revenues within one to two years.
guidance.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates turnover from the manufacturing facility at full utilization to reach INR70 crores to INR80 crores.
guidance.quote: It will come to around INR70 crores to INR80 crores.

guidance.claim: Management projects growth of 15% to 20% in the textile ink market and 20% to 30% in the wood coating market.
guidance.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say. And for the wood coating market it will be more like 20% to 30% in wood coating.

demand_outlook.claim: The near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.
demand_outlook.quote: From a demand standpoint, the near-term export environment remains somewhat cautioned due to global macro uncertainties and evolving trade dynamics.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the company expects to selectively expand its market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic wood coating segment, encouraged by improving demand trends.
demand_outlook.quote: Encouraged by improving demand trends, we expect to selectively expand our market presence and enhance distribution reach in the domestic segment.

demand_outlook.claim: India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintain strong sustainable growth supported by rising domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, India's textile and apparel industry is expected to maintaining strong sustainable growth supporting by rising the domestic consumption and expanding export opportunities.

demand_outlook.claim: The recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal open significant growth opportunities for Indian textile and furniture exports.
demand_outlook.quote: Thirdly, the recent India-EU Free Trade Agreement and India-US trade deal opens a significant growth opportunities for Indian textile exports as well as furniture exports by eliminating duties on most of the products, narrowing the competitive gap with countries like Bangladesh and Pakistan.

demand_outlook.claim: India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing as Bangladesh faces various challenges.
demand_outlook.quote: The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.

demand_outlook.claim: Both the textile ink and wood coating segments are growing exceptionally well.
demand_outlook.quote: Rohan, now both the segments are growing exceptionally and I am looking for 15% to 20% in the ink market in the textile market, I mean to say.

capex_expansion.claim: The Vadodara plant facility is spread over 10 acres of land with a 72,000 square feet automated setup and an installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: The Facility is spread over 10 acres of land with 72,000 square feet automated setup and the plant has been installed capacity of 500 metric tons per month and operates on a boiler-less, zero-carbon and zero-discharge model, aligned with our sustainability which is the first philosophy.

capex_expansion.claim: The company is in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through internal resources.
capex_expansion.quote: Additionally, we are in the process of adding new machinery over the next couple of months, funded through our internal resources, which will enable us to expand our product portfolio and enter adjacent categories as well.

capex_expansion.claim: The company opened a branch at Kochi three months prior as a furniture manufacturing hub.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, 3 months before, we have been opened a branch at Kochi which is a very good manufacturing hub for the furniture.

capex_expansion.claim: The company commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara.
capex_expansion.quote: Commissioned a state-of-the-art automated manufacturing facility in Vadodara, marking the company’s strategic shift from trading to a manufacturing-led model to enhance margins, scalability, and operational control.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production commenced at the first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat, spread over 10 acres with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
capex_expansion.quote: I am pleased to share that this quarter marks a significant milestone for Silkflex Polymers India Limited with the commencement of commercial production at our first manufacturing facility in Vadodara, Gujarat. Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

capex_expansion.claim: The facility is designed with utilities and storage already installed for further expansion without requiring additional capex.
capex_expansion.quote: Yes, Ryan. We already set up our factory in a major factors like, you can say utility, cooling plant, monomer storage capacity, already we have been instaledl according to the expansion capacity for the further expansion. So we need not require for more capex.

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%.
margins_costs.quote: With this backward integration is expected to improve EBITDA margins by approximately 20% to 25%, reduce our import dependency and enhance supply reliability.

margins_costs.claim: Input costs have remained volatile with raw materials seeing a sharp increase during the year driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.
margins_costs.quote: On the supply side, input costs have remained volatile. To put this in perspective, raw materials saw a sharp increase during the year, largely driven by global supply disruptions and geopolitical factors.

margins_costs.claim: The proactive inventory strategy has helped secure raw materials at favourable blended costs to provide margin stability over the near term.
margins_costs.quote: However, our proactive inventory strategy has helped us secure raw materials at favourable blended costs, which should provide margin stability over the near term.

margins_costs.claim: The shift from trading to a manufacturing model aims to strengthen margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility.
margins_costs.quote: Transitioned from a trading-led to a manufacturing-led model, strengthening margins, quality control, and supply chain visibility

margins_costs.claim: Q3 FY26 EBITDA increased by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores due to better operating leverage and cost control.
margins_costs.quote: The profitability improved significantly during the quarter with the EBITDA increasing by 130.78% year-on-year to INR7.11 crores. Mainly due to better operating leverage and cost control.

margins_costs.claim: Q3 FY26 EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points year-on-year to 21.2%.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margin expanded 1,150 basis points to 21.2% from 9.7% in the quarter 3 from the financial year '25.

margins_costs.claim: Manufacturing EBITDA margins are currently around 25% and are expected to reach near about 50% according to production.
margins_costs.quote: Currently our margin in manufacturing is around 25%. And in the coming time, we can expect margins to be near about 50% according to the production.

margins_costs.claim: Basic raw material prices at the plant have not seen any significant changes in the last two years.
margins_costs.quote: In the last 2 years, we haven't seen any significant changes. So, we don't expect too many changes in price movements.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization stood at approximately 60% in the first year of operations.
orders_capacity.quote: Capacity utilization stood at present approximately 60% in the first year of operations and scaling this remains a key priority for FY2027.

orders_capacity.claim: The new facility has an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Spread over 10 acres with a 72,000 square feet state-of-the-art automated plant, the facility is designed to produce our flagship products, Silkbond 35 Binder & Silkflex Glue, with an installed capacity of 500 tons per month.

orders_capacity.claim: Capacity utilization reached around 60% in the first two months (November and December) after starting manufacturing.
orders_capacity.quote: In first 2 months, that is November and December, after starting the manufacturing, we utilized around 60% capacity.

capital_allocation.claim: The distribution business accounted for 75.9% of revenue in FY26, while manufacturing contributed 24.1%.
capital_allocation.quote: In the first year of manufacturing, the distribution business accounted for 75.9% of our revenue, while manufacturing contributed 24.1%, with a clear pathway for scaling up going forward.

capital_allocation.claim: Out of the manufacturing project funding, INR30 crores is a bank loan and INR20 crores was funded through the IPO, internal accruals, and unsecured loans from promoters.
capital_allocation.quote: Out of that INR30 crores is our loan from the bank and so far as the INR20 crores, it was funded through IPO to purchase the land for INR10 crores and the rest of the amount from internal accrual and unsecured loan from promoters.

capital_allocation.claim: The company's short-term borrowings carry an interest rate of 8.5%.

risks_headwinds.claim: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to import costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: The US dollar exchange rate adds a layer of currency risk to our import cost.

risks_headwinds.claim: Bangladesh faces challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production costs, and stricter compliance requirements.
risks_headwinds.quote: The China Plus One strategy has gained momentum and with Bangladesh facing challenges such as power disruptions, political unrest, rising production cost, and stricter compliances requirements, India has emerged as a preferred destination for garment and fabric sourcing.

management_commitments.claim: The company aims to increase the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of its revenue mix.
management_commitments.quote: Looking ahead to FY2027, our priorities remain clear: scaling manufacturing utilization, increasing the contribution of manufacturing towards 50% of our revenue mix, expanding binder sales into non-textile industries as well and deepening our engagement with global brands.

management_commitments.claim: The company envisions establishing Silkflex as a fully integrated, solvent-free, zero-discharge manufacturing company by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, our vision is to establish Silkflex as a fully integrated, solvent-free, zero-discharge manufacturing company among the most advanced and sustainable players in India's textile and coating solution space.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.
management_commitments.quote: Additionally, we plan to establish a presence in various locations throughout India by partnering with selling agents.

management_commitments.claim: Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by an advanced and sustainable textile coating facility by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: By 2030, Silkflex aims to operate as a fully integrated manufacturing company supported by one of India's most advanced and sustainable textile coating facilities.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to achieve full plant capacity utilization by the next financial year.
management_commitments.quote: By looking the demand across the market by next financial year, we will achieve full capacity that we are hoping.

management_commitments.claim: Trading and manufacturing mix is expected to reach a 50:50 ratio within one to two years.
management_commitments.quote: Like 50% import and 50% products we may be manufacturing like that within 1 and 2 years.

management_commitments.claim: Management plans to establish the company as a fully manufacturing unit and market leader by 2030.
management_commitments.quote: See, we will establish fully manufacturing unit considering by 2030. And try to become a market leader by giving sustainable eco-friendly solution to the textile as well as the wood coating industry.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
